jobs.title: Technical Officer
jobs.description:
**Job Purpose:**

The role holder is responsible for carrying out production planning, complying with the standards (food safety \& Job safety) and company policies.

**Principal Accountabilities:**

* To execute production planning, complying with the quality standards along with customer specifications.

•Responsible for monitoring the utilization of utilities (steam, water, electricity) effectively.

•To maintain the accountability of stock (raw materials, packaging materials), utility consumption and the production details.

•Responsible for managing the manpower effectively, for improving the productivity.

•Responsible for tracing any deviations and to establish the corrective \& preventive action.

•Responsible for ensuring the sanitation procedure of equipment, work tools, and work environment.

•To educate the workforce about the GMP practices, Food safety, teamwork etc.

•To have control on documents and records.

•Responsible to provide reliable and accurate data during the stock closure or during the audits.

**Key Interactions**

Internal: Operator, Assistant Operator \& CL – Effectively handle the staff to sustain \& improve the productivity objective.

Internal: Quality\- Coordinate with the quality team to out produce standard products through standard processing.

Internal: SAP Team – Communicate the production accountability details and to maintain the same. External: NA

Knowledge, Skills and Experience:

**Educational Qualifications:** B. Tech/ M. Tech, Food Technology/Dairy Technology/ Food Process Engineering/ Food Science/ Dairy Science /B.Voc\-Dairy Production\&Technology; B.Sc. Food and Nutrition (4 years).

**Experience** : 0 to 2 years.

**Knowledge:**

Knowledge on Dairy Processing

Knowledge on Production planning, men and material

Knowledge in FSMS, QMS, Health \& Work safety

**Skills:**

Managerial Skills, Co\-ordination Skills and Communication Skills.

Planning and Organizing Skills,Interpersonal Skills \& Positive Attitude

**Additional requirement:** 

Soft Skills: MS Office, SAP Basics

Ready to travel extensively

Ready to relocate

Pay: ₹21,000\.00 \- ₹26,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
Trained Graduate Teacher (TGT) – All Subjects Required

**Job Title:** Trained Graduate Teacher (TGT) – All Subjects  
**Department:** Middle / Secondary School  
**Reports To:** Principal / Academic Coordinator / Head of Department

Job Summary

We are seeking qualified, dedicated, and enthusiastic **Trained Graduate Teachers (TGT)** to teach students at the middle and secondary levels. The teacher will be responsible for delivering high\-quality, curriculum\-based instruction, assessing student performance, maintaining classroom discipline, and supporting students’ overall academic and personal development.

Key Responsibilities

* Plan and deliver engaging, curriculum\-based lessons for assigned subjects.
* Teach **English, Hindi, Mathematics, Science, Social Science, Computer Science, and other subjects** according to qualification and school requirements.
* Prepare lesson plans, worksheets, assignments, projects, question papers, and teaching resources.
* Use interactive, activity\-based, and technology\-enabled teaching methods.
* Conduct regular tests, assessments, examinations, and revision sessions.
* Monitor student performance and provide additional academic support where required.
* Identify individual learning needs and implement appropriate teaching strategies.
* Maintain classroom discipline and create a safe, respectful, and inclusive learning environment.
* Develop students’ critical thinking, creativity, communication, and problem\-solving skills.
* Maintain accurate attendance, academic, and assessment records.
* Communicate with parents/guardians regarding students’ academic progress when required.
* Participate in school functions, examinations, staff meetings, workshops, training programs, and co\-curricular activities.
* Collaborate with other teachers and school management to improve academic outcomes.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor’s Degree in the **relevant subject** from a recognized university.
* **B.Ed. / equivalent recognized teacher\-training qualification.**
* CTET/TET qualification will be an advantage.
* Strong subject knowledge and understanding of relevant teaching methodologies.
* Previous teaching experience in a recognized school is preferred.

Key Skills

* Excellent subject knowledge
* Strong communication and presentation skills
* Effective classroom management
* Lesson planning and assessment
* Technology\-enabled teaching
* Student mentoring and motivation
* Critical thinking and problem\-solving
* Teamwork and collaboration
* Good organizational and time\-management skills

**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Experience:** 1–5 years preferred  
**Subjects:** All TGT Subjects / Subject as per Qualification  
**Classes:** Middle \& Secondary School  
**Location:** \[School/Institution Location]
